title: Fixed Open Case Pinned Cylinder Music Box
description: One newly authored complete fixed-open cylinder music-box appearance. A continuous timber-like shell has a real floor and four thick walls, with one complete recessed lid held in a fixed raised pose by hinge-style pins and side stays. Inside, two bearing blocks support a whole transverse drum and common axle. Twenty-four blunt fixed pegs project from the drum; one connected comb has twelve full fingers sharing a supported root. A side crank and grip belong to the same axle. This is not a fishing compartment box with contents swapped, a wheel-bowed instrument with strings removed, or a texture representing the internal mechanism: all geometry is independently authored as one complete musical-device exterior. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and whole horizontally centred ground datum. One model and zero scenes. Static silent illustrative display only: no melody, tuning, audible output, actuating pin-comb contact sequence, rotating crank/drum, hinge motion, gearing or stored energy, fabrication, operation or safety claim.
